channel.title: Upper Merion Township, Montgomery County, PA — Meeting Digest
channel.description: Plain-language digests of Upper Merion Township, Montgomery County, PA Board of Supervisors meetings, generated from official public minutes. Unofficial, not affiliated with the township.

item.title: Board of Supervisors — 2026-08-13
item.description:
• **Data center development boom:** The Board considered five separate preliminary land development applications for data centers ranging from 187,952 sq ft to 1,923,866 sq ft in the King of Prussia area, all in Suburban Metropolitan and industrial zoning districts.
  • **Apartment building approved:** A preliminary/final land development plan for a 205-unit apartment building at 720 Vandenburg Road on 6.85 acres in the King of Prussia Mixed-Use district was on the agenda for consideration.
  • **Water pollution control equipment:** The Board approved transferring $32,000.00 to replace three rotors on the rotary press at Trout Run WPCC.
  • **Social worker funding:** A supplemental budget appropriation of $74,320.00 was approved to add a TLC Social Worker position funded by a PCCD grant.
  • **Streambank project completed:** Final payment of $85,000.00 was approved for Stonewood Landshaping for the Balligomingo PS Streambank Stabilization project, which came in $19,600.00 under the original contract price.
  • **Vehicle auction proceeds:** The Board approved disposing of township vehicles through J.J. Kane Auctions with a total sale value of $10,900.00.
  • **Tax settlement:** Authorization was given for a real estate tax settlement with 320 DeKalb Partners LLC resulting in a refund of $6,718.05 in overpaid taxes for 2025-2026.

item.title: Board of Supervisors — 2026-07-16
item.description:
• **Warehouse clubs and gas stations in KPMU:** The Board discussed allowing warehouse clubs and gasoline sales as conditional uses in the King of Prussia Mixed Use (KPMU) District through a proposed zoning text amendment.
  • **Steep slope standards:** Proposed amendments would change standards for development on significantly steep slopes in the KPMU District.
  • **R-2 corner lot rules:** The Board reviewed changes to building envelope requirements for corner lots in the R-2 Residential District that would expand the permitted development area compared to interior lots.

item.title: Board of Supervisors — 2026-07-09
item.description:
• **Public Safety promotions and new hires:** Judge Krouse swore in Matthew Spears as Fire Captain, Paul Brown as Deputy Fire Marshal, and Roger Shortridge as Paramedic.
  • **Moore Road Multimodal Trail invoices approved:** The Board approved two invoices totaling $85,322.83 ($53,707.53 and $31,615.30) to Traffic Planning & Design, Inc. for contract services, to be paid with Commonwealth Financing Authority grant funds.
  • **Heuser Phase 2 Master Site Plan consultant selected:** Simone Collins Landscape Architecture was chosen as the design consultant for Heuser Park 2 Master Plan at a cost of $149,515.00, as recommended by the Parks & Recreation Advisory Board.
  • **Revenue Stabilization Fund commitment:** The Board approved designating $3,000,000.00 in the Revenue Stabilization Fund as committed fund balance in the 2026 financial statements.
  • **Recharge Park payment approved:** Payment Application No. 8 for $101,537.46 was approved to Patriot Grounds & Site Services for work on Recharge Park, funded by Montco 2040 grant funds.
  • **Centenarian and Juneteenth honored:** The Board issued proclamations honoring centenarian John Bazela and Juneteenth (June 19, 2025).
